# casdoor_group (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor group.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_group" "engineering" {
  owner        = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name         = "engineering"
  display_name = "Engineering"
  type         = "Virtual"
  parent_id    = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  is_top_group = true
  is_enabled   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `contact_email` (String) The contact email.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `gid_number` (Number) The POSIX GID published by the built-in LDAP server, 0 when not assigned.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the group is enabled.
- `is_top_group` (Boolean) Whether the group is a top-level group.
- `manager` (String) The manager of the group.
- `parent_id` (String) The name of the parent group, or the organization name for a top-level group.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom properties.
- `type` (String) The type, `Virtual` or `Physical`.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the group was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the group in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_group.example <organization>/<name>
```
